verdict: YES: observer-only scope and O13-6 conditions approved
approvedScope: Source implementation of experiments/moriarty-midnight-financial/ledger/observe-preview-funding.mjs and its callable isolated tests only. Apply all O13-6 conditions. No accounting.py or cmd_run/records/runner/store integration, lock acquisition/handoff, charge/claim, admission receipt-field completion, correspondence, live wallet access, real SDK invocation or live observation is authorized by this shared scope. Frozen implementation requires both fresh full-source audits.
reasoning: The direct restore/start/sync/stop and exact available-funds calculation interfaces are independently implementable without the accounting producer. Explicit expected network, role identity, selected token, wallet-state location and result destination are caller inputs, not authority selected by the module. Unknown or mismatched inputs must reject.

Controlled SDK doubles or transports and fixture-only seed/snapshot inputs allow actual callable behavior and partial-initialization/late-completion cleanup to be tested without real wallet access. Harness-side before/after input digests and forbidden API/write traps provide independent evidence for those fixture outcomes.

A public aggregate module result may be written only to the explicit safe result destination, outside wallet state. This is not completion or authentication of the funding-admission receipt: allocationId, preflightChargeId, pendingUseDispositionSha256 and correspondence remain excluded. No lock or grant handling is added to make the module appear integrated.

Ready requires verified identity/network, fresh nonfuture syncTime, strictly complete connected progress, appropriate pending-use evidence and confirmed stop of every created child. Restore/sync/stop failure, timeout or late completion must return named unavailable without fallback. Neither fixture success nor ready module output establishes live funding.
conditions: All O13-6 explicit caller-input, no-secret/password, no-fallback, public-output, stop-confirmation, fixture digest, forbidden API/write and timeout/late-completion conditions apply.
Only isolated tests may call the observer in this scope; no real SDK or live wallet invocation.
Both required fresh reviewers must audit the exact frozen implemented source and tests before source acceptance.
reviewRelationship: This clarification narrows the common implementation scope of the two current votes. Astra initial review remains preserved as its independent historical verdict. Opus producer blockers O13-1..3 are not waived, resolved or re-reviewed here, and there is no producer approval convergence.
limitations: Read O13-6 and surrounding Opus scope after completing the independent original review, solely for the requested scope reconciliation.
No status call, tests, SDK execution, wallet read, lock/store/master mutation or production edit during this clarification. Only this clarification JSON was written.
